Veterans Benefits: Pennsylvania does not tax retirement income, including military retired pay. The state offers a Disabled Veterans Real Estate Tax Exemption that fully exempts the primary residence of 100% permanent and total service-connected disabled veterans, subject to a need-based income test.

Description: Carlisle is the seat of Cumberland County in south-central Pennsylvania, home to Carlisle Barracks and the U.S. Army War College and to Dickinson College. It stands out in this batch for combining a low crime rate, a perfect 100 HRC Municipal Equality Index score, and Pennsylvania's full exemption of retirement income. Nearby VA outpatient care sits about 15 miles east in Mechanicsburg; the nearest VA hospital is Lebanon, roughly 45 miles away.
